title: Dog Training
excerpt: 1-2-1 training at your home or locally with a qualified trainer, plus our Have a Go Dog Agility Workshops at our training field in Normandy.
intro: Group classes aren't right for every dog or every diary. Our qualified, friendly trainers offer 1-2-1 sessions at your home or in your local area, tailored to you and your dog. We assess what your dog needs and take your handling into account too. We want to set you up for success.
pricingNote: Training has its own booking line: call 07714 944241 or email TTLS.training@hotmail.com.

prices.label: 1-2-1 training consultation
prices.detail: A one-hour session at your home or locally, including an assessment of your dog's needs, an emailed training plan and two weeks of email support.

workshop.title: Have a Go *Dog Agility* Workshop
workshop.subtitle: Introduction to agility
workshop.intro: Tea, coffee, biscuits, wagging tails and plenty of like-minded dog lovers. What more could you want? Whether your dog is a future agility star or just loves an adventure, it's the perfect chance to try something new, have a laugh and enjoy time with great people and happy dogs.
points: Suitable for all breeds and ages
